Only this geometry and recorded discrete native trajectory; no dynamics or continuous collision guarantee.

Inline R-R-R-P feeding mechanism with 100 mm rod and real 15–25 mm radial adjustment slot; three native settings verify 30/40/50 mm strokes and time ratio 1.0. Each has 121 native frames, STEP/PRT/SIM reopen and cold GUI acceptance. No clamp-force, friction or payload validation.

Short closed pivoting sleeve and long sliding rod. Ground is the original connecting rod; the original slider rocks about its grounded revolute. Only this geometry and recorded discrete native trajectory; no dynamics or continuous collision guarantee.

Fixed short sleeve is the original slider. The original frame becomes a long translating pump rod; an 80 mm grounded rocker drives a 45 mm connecting member. It is not a moving slider block on a grounded long rail. The 35 mm candidate was rejected before modeling because its maximum pressure angle was 58.9 degrees; 45 mm keeps it below 45 degrees. Only this geometry and recorded discrete native trajectory; no dynamics or continuous collision guarantee.

Long pivoted T-slot guide and captive moving slider block. Ground is the original crank; the P pair travels with the guide. Only this geometry and recorded discrete native trajectory; no dynamics or continuous collision guarantee.
